newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - March 6.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - March 6.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Bunker prices were steady on Thursday with modest demand, traders said. But with weak swaps, prices could be in a downtrend, they said. Some 2,000 tonnes of 380-cst grade was sold at $99 per tonne. "Comparatively, prices here are still quite high and there are no fundamentals behind them. I see more of a downside potential," said one trader.
